membership_rationale: Direct-lending private credit in a non-traded BDC chassis: the same strategy as cclfx on different plumbing (150% asset-coverage leverage, discretionary quarterly tenders, monthly NAV). Admitted deliberately cross-wrapper so the caveat machinery has real work.
what: typed projections of evidenced cells, zero new facts. Every field carries its source_cell and mirrors its status

mgmt_fee_base.note: month-start net assets, payable monthly and settled quarterly

value.structure: two-part BDC fee: 12.5% of income over a 5.0% annualized hurdle with 100% catch-up, PLUS 12.5% of realized capital gains

gate_history.note: Q2-2026 tender: requests exceeded the quarterly limit and were accepted pro rata (10-Q footnote 4), the first printed gating. FY2023 to FY2025 tenders were satisfied in full (R2-P1-12 rule)
